WPS = 70% do nível declarado (W) + 30% d: WPS = 70% reported level (W) + 30% frequency of distinct photos (F), within the same confirmed water body, 200 m and the 30 days preceding the report. Pending similarities/reused images do not increase F. This experimental formula is unchanged; more photos can increase F without proving more pollution. CS = average confidence × 0.8; it is not a calibrated probability of accuracy.
Hashes identificam os arquivos/pixels us: Hashes identify the files/pixels used; they do not prove authenticity, capture date or location.

Compara a última observação antes e a pr: Compares the last observation before and the first after the action within the same group. Dates are submission dates. Framing, frequency and evidence can affect results; comparison does not demonstrate that the action caused the change.
